segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine. The confetti budget has been approved. So has the target.

segments.title: ₹1.52L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Pop-up is 1.52 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent up on last April. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 66,800 rupees. That's 4 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 60,000, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 1,500. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 40 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 469 leads, 122 trials, and 40 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 1.03 lakh rupees, which is 68 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: First up, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine bonus days. Bring three, and get a whole month. Presents for presents, because it's our birthday. The plan is 1 buyer at about 5,900, so 5,900 rupees.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes, including the birthday party class, at a tiny price that comes off their first month if they join. Everyone's invited. The plan is 3 buyers at about 4,900, so 14,700 rupees.

segments.title: Where Are They Now?
segments.text: Then, for old friends, Where Are They Now? Fifteen per cent off to come back, a bonus class for every year they've known us, and a seat at the Throwback Reunion. A lot has changed. We got prettier. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,200, so 21,700 rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15% + max 3 bonus classes (≤20% effective on a 12-class pack)

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, Spin Class, literally. Renew in April for ten per cent off, then spin the Wheel of Nine. Every spin wins, and the odds are on the wall, because we're fit, not shady. The plan is 8 buyers at about 7,700, so 61,200 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, the party class brings new faces in, and every guest gets a follow-up. Week three, the wheel spins and the Club Nine seats close. Week four, the Throwback Reunion brings old friends home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Pop-up. 1.52 lakh rupees, four offers, and 40 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
